headline: Singapore Equity Funds Draw Record $2.2 Billion Inflows on Bank Dividends
summary: Singapore equity funds recorded unprecedented third-quarter inflows of $2.2 billion, supported by robust dividend payouts from domestic bank stocks.
why: Singapore is a major financial hub in Southeast Asia, with its stock exchange attracting global capital seeking stable dividend yields from major regional banks.

impacts.name: Singapore Equities Market
impacts.why: Record fund inflows of $2.2 billion entered Singapore equity funds during the third quarter.
